title: DOE Southline Transmission Capacity Contract Award
summary: DOE's Transmission Facilitation Program page records $477 million awarded to the proposed 175-mile, 748 MW Southline project between New Mexico and Arizona through a capacity contract.
key_findings: DOE lists the first-phase Southline Transmission Project as a $477 million awarded action.
The proposed line would extend 175 miles from Hidalgo County, New Mexico to Pima County, Arizona.
The page distinguishes active awards from projects whose negotiations or agreements were later withdrawn or terminated.
why_it_matters: This converts a national transmission-needs signal into a named project-level financing action and makes later delivery gates observable.
ftfn_relevance: Adds a project, corridor, capacity, financial mechanism, and awarded amount to the transmission evidence stack.
Supports monitoring from award through permits, construction, interconnection, energization, and delivered service.
evidence_limits: An awarded capacity contract does not prove construction, energization, or delivery of 748 MW.
The page's expected construction timing is not a verified progress report and requires current project records.
